content_sections.text: Senior Associate (Policy): Engineering/technology degree in a branch relevant to the portfolio applied for. Associate (Evaluation and Data): Degree or post-graduation with statistical methods and data science as examined subjects; working knowledge of R, Python, Stata or SPSS. Project Manager (Projects, Accounts and Administration): Master's in management, commerce, public administration or social work; or Bachelor's with a professional accounting qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Mumbai Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Mumbai to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 is 09-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies are available for the posts of Senior Associate (Policy), Associate (Evaluation and Data), Research Associate, and Project Manager in the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Associate (Evaluation and Data) post?
faq.answer: For the Associate (Evaluation and Data) post, candidates need a degree or post-graduation with statistical methods and data science as examined subjects, along with working knowledge of R, Python, Stata, or SPSS.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the posts advertised by IIM Mumbai?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by IIM Mumbai in this recruitment is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a computer-based written test (online, remote), a campus-based test, and a panel interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Associate (Policy) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Associate (Policy) position is ₹15.00 lakh per annum plus ₹1.20 lakh per annum as travel and field allowance.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Maharashtra. It is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification for specific state requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job in IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature for all the advertised posts in the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026.
